purpose: Independent-target confirmation of the exploratory additive-noise result. The source pipeline remains ASVspoof 2019 LA; the previously unseen target is the official DeepSpeak v2 test identity split.

dataset.full_revision_resolution: Resolve through the Hugging Face API before the first media shard; the resolved SHA must start with dd0d22e and is written to outputs/acquisition/revision_record.json.
dataset.redistribution_rule: Do not commit or redistribute restricted media, extracted audio, transcripts, or raw restricted annotations.

source.reuse_rule: Use exactly the frozen source clips, preprocessing and deterministic noise mapping from the completed pilot. DeepSpeak is never used for fitting, feature selection, threshold selection or calibration.

target.real_rule: identity in official test split AND script-type in {scripted-short, unscripted}
target.fake_rule: identity-source and identity-target in official test split AND audio-config in {elevenlabs, playht, speechify} AND script-type in {scripted-short, unscripted}

conditions.noise: clean source training clips plus one deterministic additive-noise copy per clip; white, pink or brown noise; SNR uniformly sampled from 5 to 20 dB using the frozen pilot mapping

selection_history.layer_10: Chosen as a fixed follow-up layer after the completed In-the-Wild exploratory layer analysis; it is not claimed to have been selected without seeing prior target results.
selection_history.C_0_1: Fixed identically for both conditions before DeepSpeak media acquisition or scoring to remove regularisation as a condition-specific confound.

evaluation.primary_contrast: EER_noise_minus_EER_none averaged over the three source-subsampling seeds
evaluation.decision_rule: Improvement is confirmed only if the entire two-sided 95% paired identity-cluster bootstrap CI for EER_noise_minus_EER_none is below zero; harm if entirely above zero; otherwise inconclusive.
secondary_metrics: balanced accuracy at the source-validation EER threshold
macro F1 at the source-validation EER threshold
evaluation.no_target_driven_changes: No target result may be used to change the layer, C, source subset, preprocessing, target manifest, threshold rule or primary decision rule.
